BDB8165 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB8167

[שָׂגָה] verb grow, increase (late; || form of שׂגא); —

Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִשְׂגֶּה Ps 92:13 righteous shall grow great like cedar (|| יִפְרַח), compare Job 8:7 (opposed to מִצְעָר; vJob 8:11 see שׂגא). Hiph`il Perfect 3 plural הִשְׂגּוּחַֿיִל Ps 73:12 they have increased riches.

שׂגיב see שְׂגוּב. שִׂגְשֵׂג see II. סוּג..
